items.html: Now, in the same manner as it is in his internality, so it is in the lights that come out of him, which are his branches, as mentioned. For the hairs of his head correspond to the branches of AB, and the hairs of the Dikna [beard] are from AHP, corresponding to the branches of SAG, in which AVI are included; for between the two of them they took the Bina of MA after the correction, which is the name SAG that includes them both, and they are included in the Mazal of the Dikna of AA. Understand this well, for so it is here. And at that time SAG still expanded down to the feet of AK.
